aiMetadata.description: Opens a new conversation thread with a specific AgentX agent (identified by agent ID), choosing the conversation type (chat, search, or ecommerce). Use this to begin an interaction before sending messages; it does not send any message itself. Each call starts a fresh conversation, so calling it repeatedly creates multiple separate conversations (not idempotent).

conversationId.description: Select a conversation for the chosen Agent

agentMode.description: Choose how the agent should respond

message.description: The message you want to send to the agent.

context.description: Number of previous messages to include. 0 = as much as possible, 1 = only last message, etc.

aiMetadata.description: Posts a message into an existing AgentX conversation (by conversation ID) and gets the agent reply, with a selectable response mode (chat or search) and an optional memory-context window controlling how many prior messages the agent considers. Use this to continue an already-created conversation; create the conversation first to obtain its ID. Each call appends a new message and produces a new reply (not idempotent).

conversationId.description: Select a conversation for the chosen Agent

searchTerm.description: Text to search for in message content. Leave blank if searching by Message ID.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves messages from a specific AgentX conversation (by agent ID and conversation ID): leave the search term blank to return all messages in the conversation, or provide a search term to return only messages whose text contains it (case-insensitive). Use this to inspect or find content within a conversation. Read-only and idempotent.

search_agents.name: search_agents
search_agents.description: Find agents by name or ID using search filters.

name.description: Search by agent name (partial matches allowed).

aiMetadata.description: Lists AgentX agents on the account, optionally narrowing the results by partial name match and/or exact agent ID; leave both filters blank to return all agents. Use this to discover available agents or resolve an agent ID before starting a conversation. Read-only and idempotent.

find_conversation.name: find_conversation
find_conversation.description: Looks up an existing conversation by Agent ID (optionally by conversation ID or Name).

auth.description:

---
### How to obtain your API key

conversationName.description: Search conversation by its name (derived from the first message).

aiMetadata.description: Lists conversations belonging to a specific AgentX agent (by agent ID); optionally filter to a single conversation by exact conversation ID, or by name (a partial, case-insensitive match against the name derived from the conversation's first message). Leave both filters blank to return all of the agent's conversations. Use this to resolve a conversation ID before sending or finding messages. Read-only and idempotent.

new_agent.name: new_agent
new_agent.description: Triggers when a new AgentX agent is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new agent is created on the AgentX account, emitting the newly created agent. Polls periodically and only surfaces agents created after the trigger was enabled.

new_conversation.name: new_conversation
new_conversation.description: Triggers when a new conversation begins with a specific Agent. Only detects conversations created after the trigger is enabled.

nl.**Enter your AgentX API Key**\n---\n###:
**Voer je Agent X API Key**
---
### Hoe je API key
1 te verkrijgen. Bezoek [AgentX](https://www.agentx.so/) en log in.
2. Klik op uw avatar (linkerbeneden).
3. Kopieer uw API-sleutel uit het pop-upvenster.
4. Plak deze hier.

nl.Send a message to an existing conversati: Stuur een bericht naar een bestaand gesprek met een agent.

nl.Looks up an existing conversation by Age: Ziet een bestaand gesprek op door Agent ID ((optioneel) op gespreksID of naam).
nl.Select a conversation for the chosen Age: Selecteer een gesprek voor de gekozen agent
nl.Choose how the agent should respond: Kies hoe de agent moet reageren

Aantal vorige berichten om op te nemen. 0 = zo veel als mogelijk, 1 = alleen laatste bericht, etc.

nl.Search conversation by its name (derived: Zoek gesprek op zijn naam (afgeleid van het eerste bericht).
nl.Triggers when a new AgentX agent is crea: Triggert wanneer een nieuwe Agent is aangemaakt.
nl.Triggers when a new conversation begins: Triggert wanneer een nieuw gesprek begint met een specifieke agent. detecteert alleen conversaties gemaakt nadat de trigger is ingeschakeld.
